test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To flog a dead horse

options.text: To waste one’s energy on a lost cause

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To waste one’s energy on a lost cause.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To flog a dead horse"** means:

 
 
• To waste one's energy on a lost cause. (एक खोए हुए कारण पर अपनी ऊर्जा बर्बाद करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Trying to change his mind about the project is like flogging a dead horse; he's already made up his decision.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To waste one’s energy on a lost cause.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To remain valid** (वैध बने रहना):

 
 
• **Example:** The contract will remain valid for the next five years.
 
 
 
• **To escape from the situation** (स्थिति से बचना):
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to escape from the situation by making an excuse.
 
 
 
• **To achieve something easily** (आसानी से कुछ हासिल करना):
 
 
• **Example:** With his experience, he can achieve the task easily.
 
 

50:Tbe1,

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **hasten**.
